    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbandonedShip
    Represents the "Abandoned Ship" encounter card.
    AbandonedStation
    Represents the "Abandoned Station" encounter card.
    AlienLifeSupportsSystem
    Represents a tile that supports a specific alien crew type (BROWN or PURPLE), providing life support for adjacent cabins containing aliens of the same type.
    AlienOptions
    Represents the compatibility of a tile with alien crew types.
    AskToChooseStartingPositionMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to ask the client to choose a starting position.
    AskToInputCoordinatesMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to ask the client to input coordinates.
    AskToRollTheDicesMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to ask the client to roll the dice.
    BatteryComponents
    Represents a ship tile that stores and manages battery cells.
    BookedTileMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about a booked tile.
    BrokenTileMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about broken tiles on the ship.
    Cabin
    Abstract class representing a cabin tile on a ship.
    CabinsManager
    Manages the cabins and crew placement on the player's ship during the game.
    Cannon
    Abstract class representing a generic cannon tile on a ship.
    CannonMessage
    Represents a message containing information about cannon usage in the game.
    Card
    Abstract base class representing a card in the game.
    CardCollection
    Represents a collection of cards used in the game.
    CardDeck
    Represents a deck of cards divided by level.
    CardsController
    The CardsController class represents the controller in a JavaFX application responsible for managing card-related functionalities in a game.
    CargoBlue
    Represents a blue cargo hold tile that can store non-hazardous goods.
    CargoHold
    Represents a cargo hold tile on a ship.
    CargoRed
    Represents a red cargo hold, which is capable of storing hazardous goods (RED).
    ChallengeType
    Enum representing different types of challenges a player may face during a card event.
    CheckShipController
    Controller for handling the ship checking phase in the Galaxy Trucker game's GUI.
    ChooseBranchMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to choose a branch in the game.
    ChooseColorController
    Controller for managing the color selection phase in the Galaxy Trucker game's GUI.
    ChooseColorMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to choose a player color in the game.
    ChooseCrewController
     
    Client
    The Client interface serves as a marker interface for client-side components in the multiplayer game.
    ClientController
    This class is responsible for managing the client-side logic of the game.
    ClientHandler
    This class represents a handler for managing the communication with a connected client.
    ClientMain
    The ClientMain class is the entry point for the client-side application in the Galaxy Trucker game.
    ClientMessage
    Abstract class representing a client message in the communication between the client and the server.
    ClientPingMessage
    Represents a ping message sent by the client to check the connectivity with the server.
    ClientState
    Enum representing the different client states during the game.
    ClientUpdater
    Utility class used to generate a serialized snapshot of the current game state to be sent to clients for synchronization purposes.
    CombatZone
    Represents a Combat Zone card that introduces one or more competitive challenges among all players.
    CombatZoneStrengthMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about the strength of a player's combat zone.
    CompletedShipMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to signal that the player's ship is completed.
    ConnectionController
    The ConnectionController class is responsible for managing the input and configuration of connection settings in the GUI.
    Connectors
    Enum representing the connector types used on tiles to determine connectivity.
    Controller
    This controller class represents the server-side object bound to each connected client.
    ControllerFactory
    Remote factory interface used to create instances of VirtualController.
    ControllerFactoryImpl
    Implementation of the ControllerFactory interface using RMI.
    ControllerInterface
    Interface defining the methods that a player can invoke to interact with the game server.
    ControllerSerializerDeserializer
    Utility class for serializing and deserializing the GameController state.
    Coordinates
    Represents a pair of coordinates (x, y) used to identify positions on a ShipBoard.
    CoordInputManager
    Class responsible for managing coordinate-based inputs from the player during various phases of the game.
    CoordReqType
    Enum representing the different types of coordinate requests in the game.
    Coverage
    Enum representing the coverage direction of a shield on a tile.
    CreateGameMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to create a new game.
    CreateNewGameController
    Controller for managing the creation of a new game in the Galaxy Trucker game's GUI.
    CrewArrangementMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to arrange crew members in the player's ship.
    CrewPenalty
    Represents a penalty that causes the player to lose crew members.
    CrewType
    Enum representing the type of crew that can be assigned to a cabin.
    CurrentGameStatusMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client of the current game status.
    DeckCheckController
    Controller for handling the deck check phase in the Galaxy Trucker game's GUI.
    Defense
    Represents the result of a projectile's interaction with a player's defenses.
    Direction
    Enum representing the four cardinal directions used in tile orientation.
    DisplayableView
    Interface representing a view that can be displayed to the user in the Galaxy Trucker game.
    DoubleCannon
    Represents a double cannon tile in the spaceship.
    DoubleEngine
    Represents a double engine tile on the ship board.
    DrawCardMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to request the drawing of a card.
    DrawnCardMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about a drawn card.
    DrawTileStackMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to request drawing a tile from the stack.
    DrawTileTurnedMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to request drawing a tile from the turned tiles stack.
    EarlyLandingMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to request an early landing.
    EarlyLandingMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about an early landing.
    EndShipController
    Controller for handling the end-of-ship phase in the Galaxy Trucker game's GUI.
    Enemies
    Abstract subclass of Card representing enemy encounters (e.g., Slavers, Smugglers, Pirates).
    Engine
    Abstract class representing an engine tile in the ship.
    EngineMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to use the engines in the game.
    Epidemic
    Represents the "Epidemic" encounter card.
    EquipCabin
    Represents a cabin tile capable of hosting crew members, including aliens.
    ErrorMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client of an error.
    FinalScoresMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client of the final scores.
    FlightBoard
    The FlightBoard class manages the positions and rankings of players during the flight phase of the game.
    FlightBoardCardsMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to update the client with the flight board cards.
    FlightboardCardsResponse
    Represents a message sent by the server to respond with a flightboard card.
    FlightDaysPenalty
    Represents a penalty that causes the player to lose a number of flight days, effectively moving them backward on the flight board.
    GainedCreditsMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client that a player has gained credits.
    Game
    Main implementation of the Galaxy Trucker game logic.
    GameController
    The GameController class manages all aspects of a single game session, including player management, game phases, tile and card handling, disconnections, state transitions, and synchronization with client views.
    GameInfo
    Represents information about a specific game session.
    GameInterface
    Represents the core interface for the Galaxy Trucker game logic.
    GameLoader
    Utility class responsible for loading saved game files from disk.
    GameMode
    Represents the available modes in a Galaxy Trucker game.
    GamePhases
    Enum representing the different phases of the game.
    GameSaver
    Utility class responsible for saving the current game state to disk.
    GameSerializerDeserializer
    Utility class for serializing and deserializing the Game object and related game state data.
    GameState
    Represents the various phases/states of a Galaxy Trucker game.
    GenericServerMessage
    Represents a generic message sent by the server to notify the client with a custom message.
    Goods
    Represents a unit of cargo in the game, defined by its GoodsColor.
    GoodsArrangementMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to arrange goods in the cargo hold.
    GoodsChecker
    Utility class responsible for validating and applying updates to the cargo hold of a Player's ShipBoard.
    GoodsColor
    Enumeration representing the possible colors of goods in the game, each associated with a credit value.
    GoodsManager
    The GoodsManager class is responsible for managing the operations related to goods in the game.
    GoodsPenalty
    Represents a penalty where the player must discard a number of goods, potentially replacing some of them with batteries if not enough goods are available.
    GUI
    The GUI class represents the graphical user interface (GUI) for the game.
    JoinGameMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to request joining an existing game.
    LargeCannonShot
    Represents a projectile fired by a large cannon.
    LargeMeteor
    Represents a large meteor projectile traveling in a specific direction.
    LeaveGameMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to request leaving the current game.
    LeaveMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to request leaving the current game.
    LightFlightboard
    This class represents a light version of the flight board in the game.
    LightPlayer
    This class represents a light version of the player in the game.
    LightShipBoard
    This class represents the light version of the shipboard in the game.
    Link
    Represents a single link (connector) on a side of a tile.
    LobbyController
    Controller for handling the lobby screen in the Galaxy Trucker game's GUI.
    LoginController
    Controller for handling the login screen in the Galaxy Trucker game's GUI.
    LoginMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to request logging into the game.
    LoginResponseMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server in response to a client's login attempt.
    LookGameCardMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to request looking at a specific game card.
    Message
    Represents a generic message used in the communication between the server and the client.
    MeteorSwarm
    Represents the Meteor Swarm event card that simulates a series of meteors hitting each player's ship.
    MockVirtualView
     
    ModifiedTilesMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about modified tiles.
    MultiGameController
    Manages multiple simultaneous game sessions in Galaxy Trucker.
    NewTurnedTileMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about a new turned tile.
    NotAvailableCardDeckMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client that certain small card decks are unavailable.
    NotAvailableColorMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client that certain player colors are unavailable.
    NotifyCombatZoneCrewMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about the number of crew members in the player's combat zone.
    NotifyCombatZoneEngineMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about the strength of a player's combat zone engine.
    Observer
    Observer interface for receiving updates about the current game state.
    OpenSpace
    Represents the "Open Space" card event where players use engines to advance.
    Penalty
    Abstract class representing a generic penalty applied to a player during the game.
    PingPong
    The PingPong class is responsible for regularly pinging active players to check the connectivity in a multiplayer game.
    Pipe
    Represents a Pipe tile used to connect components within a ship.
    Pirates
    Represents the "Pirates" enemy card.
    Planet
    Represents a planet card that offers a list of goods to the player who lands on it.
    PlanetChoiceMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to choose a planet in the game.
    Planets
    Represents a card containing a set of planets, each with associated goods.
    Player
    Represents a player in the Galaxy Trucker game.
    PlayerDisconnectedMessage
     
    PlayerInterface
    This interface defines a minimal contract for any class that represents a player in the game by exposing their assigned player color.
    PlayerJoinedMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client when a player joins the game.
    PlayerLandedOnPlanetMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client that a player has landed on a planet.
    PlayerLeavesMessage
     
    PlayerMovementMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about a player's movement in the game.
    PlayersColor
    Enum representing the possible player colors in the game.
    PlayerSerializerDeserializer
    Utility class responsible for serializing and deserializing Player objects.
    PodiumMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about the podium of the game.
    PositionedTileMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about a tile that has been positioned.
    Projectile
    Abstract class representing a generic projectile fired during gameplay.
    ProjectilePenalty
    Represents a penalty involving one or more projectile impacts on a player's ship.
    RefuseTileMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to refuse a tile.
    RemoveCrewMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to remove crew members from specific locations.
    RemovedBookedTileMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client that a previously booked tile has been removed.
    RemoveGoodsMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to remove goods from specific locations.
    RemoveTurnedTileMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client that a turned tile should be removed.
    RMIServer
    This class sets up and runs an RMI server for the Galaxy Trucker game.
    RollDicesMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to request rolling the dice in the game.
    S_EndDrawTilesCardsController
    Controller for managing the end of the tile drawing phase and card deck in the Galaxy Trucker game's GUI.
    S_ManageDrawTileController
    Controller for managing the drawn tiles in the Galaxy Trucker game's GUI.
    SendNoMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to indicate a "No" response.
    SendYesMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to indicate a "Yes" response.
    Server
    The Server interface defines the methods required for server-side operations in a multiplayer game.
    ServerHandler
    The ServerHandler class is responsible for handling communication between the client and the server.
    ServerMain
    The main entry point for starting the server for the Galaxy Trucker game.
    ServerMessage
    Represents a base class for all server messages.
    ServerPingMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to ping the client.
    SetClientStateMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to set the client's state.
    SetFlightBoardPositionMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to set the flight board position.
    SetGameModeMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to set the game mode on the client.
    SetTileMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to set a specific tile on the game board.
    Shields
    Represents a shield tile in the game, which can protect one of the four corners of the ship (North-East, South-East, South-West, North-West).
    ShipBoard
    Represents a ship board in the Galaxy Trucker game.
    ShipBoardInterface
    Interface representing the public contract for a ShipBoard in Galaxy Trucker.
    ShipBoardSerializerDeserializer
    Utility class for serializing and deserializing the ShipBoard of a Player.
    ShipErrorManagementMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to manage ship errors.
    ShipIsCorrectMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client that their ship is correctly assembled.
    ShowDiceRollMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about the result of a dice roll.
    ShowDrawnTileMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about a tile that has been drawn.
    ShowJoinableGamesMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client about available joinable games.
    SingleCannon
    Represents a single cannon tile in the game.
    SingleEngine
    Represents a single engine tile in the game.
    Slavers
    Represents the "Slavers" enemy card in the game.
    SmallCannonShot
    Represents a small cannon projectile shot in a given direction.
    SmallMeteor
    Represents a small meteor projectile.
    Smugglers
    Represents the "Smugglers" enemy card.
    SocketServer
    The SocketServer class is responsible for managing a server that listens for incoming socket connections from clients.
    StarDust
    Represents the "StarDust" encounter card.
    StartController
    Controller for handling the start screen in the Galaxy Trucker game's GUI.
    StartingCabin
    Represents the Starting Cabin of a player's ship.
    StopLookingCardsMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to stop looking at the cards.
    TextualInputParser
    Class responsible for parsing the textual input received from the user and updating the state of the game based on the input.
    Tile
    Abstract class representing a tile component in the ship grid.
    TileBookingMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to book a tile in the game.
    TileFactory
    A factory class for creating and managing Tile objects from JSON resources or string data.
    TileFactory.JsonTile
    Inner static class used for JSON deserialization of tiles.
    TimeExpiredMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client that the allotted time has expired.
    TrialCardDeck
    Represents a trial deck used for test or demo purposes.
    TUI
    A text-based user interface (TUI) for interacting with the game.
    TurnedHourglassMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client that the hourglass has been turned.
    TurnHourglassMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to trigger the action of turning the hourglass.
    TypeOfCrew
    Enum representing the different types of crew that can occupy a cabin or tile.
    UpdateDeserializer
    Utility class responsible for deserializing the game update string sent by the server and applying it to the ClientController to synchronize the client-side state.
    UseBatteryMessage
    Represents a message sent by the client to use batteries at specific coordinates in the game.
    VictimOfThePenaltyMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client that a player has become the victim of a penalty.
    ViewInterface
    Interface for the view in the game, which handles all interactions and updates the client with the game's state.
    VirtualController
    The VirtualController interface defines the remote methods available for the controller in the Galaxy Trucker game.
    VirtualControllerRMI
    The VirtualControllerRMI class provides the implementation for the remote control of the game server, interacting with the game logic through the Controller class and managing the communication with the client via RMI.
    VirtualControllerSocket
    The `VirtualControllerSocket` class is an implementation of the `VirtualController` interface for handling client-server communication in the socket-based architecture of the game.
    VirtualView
    Virtual view interface for handling the communication between the game logic and the view layer over the network.
    VirtualViewRMI
    RMI implementation of the VirtualView interface.
    VirtualViewSocket
    Implementation of the VirtualView interface that communicates with the server through the client handler.
    VoidTile
    Represents a VoidTile, a special type of tile used as a placeholder for invalid or non-usable areas of the ship grid.
    WelcomeController
    Controller for handling the welcome screen in the Galaxy Trucker game's GUI.
    WrongInputMessage
    Represents a message sent by the server to notify the client that the input provided by the client was incorrect.
